summary: Save desktop looks as presets and apply them again
description: Save the look of your desktop (shell family, bar, theme, typography, icons, wallpaper, dock, surfaces, panels) as named presets in folders, and apply one with a click. Preview what an apply would change, update a preset from the current look, and undo the last apply. Presets are plain files in a folder you can back up or share. Native Material, iRiS and Waffle styling.

1.0.0: Initial release: save looks by group, apply with or without wallpaper, preview, update, undo.
